1) Propositional logic:

1.01) Axm. A01 (Weakening / Positive Implicative Axiom; K-Axiom; Russian: Утверждение следствия):
           (α → (β → α))
           Typing judgment: ((α : Bool) ∧ (β : Bool))

1.02) Axm. A02 (Distribution of Implication):
           ((α → (β → γ)) → ((α → β) → (α → γ)))
           Typing judgment: ((α : Bool) ∧ ((β : Bool) ∧ (γ : Bool)))

1.03) Axm. A03 (Conjunction Elimination Left):
           ((α ∧ β) → α)
           Typing judgment: ((α : Bool) ∧ (β : Bool))

1.04) Axm. A04 (Conjunction Elimination Right):
           ((α ∧ β) → β)
           Typing judgment: ((α : Bool) ∧ (β : Bool))

1.05) Axm. A05 (Conjunction Introduction):
           (α → (β → (α ∧ β)))
           Typing judgment: ((α : Bool) ∧ (β : Bool))

1.06) Axm. A06 (Disjunction Introduction Left):
           (α → (α ∨ β))
           Typing judgment: ((α : Bool) ∧ (β : Bool))

1.07) Axm. A07 (Disjunction Introduction Right):
           (β → (α ∨ β))
           Typing judgment: ((α : Bool) ∧ (β : Bool))

1.08) Axm. A08 (Disjunction Elimination / Cases):
           ((α → γ) → ((β → γ) → ((α ∨ β) → γ)))
           Typing judgment: ((α : Bool) ∧ ((β : Bool) ∧ (γ : Bool)))

1.09) Axm. A09 (Negation Elimination / Contradiction to Bottom):
           ((¬α) → (α → ⊥))
           Typing judgment: (α : Bool)

1.10) Axm. A10 (Reductio Ad Absurdum / Negation Introduction):
           ((α → β) → ((α → ¬β) → ¬α))
           Typing judgment: ((α : Bool) ∧ (β : Bool))

1.11) Axm. A11 (Ex Falso Quodlibet):
           (⊥ → α)
           Typing judgment: (α : Bool)

1.12) Axm. A12 (Law of Excluded Middle):
           (α ∨ ¬α)
           Typing judgment: (α : Bool)

1.13) Rule Modus Ponens (MP):
           α, (α → β) ⊢ β
           Typing judgment: ((α : Bool) ∧ (β : Bool))

2) Predicate logic:

2.01) Axm. Discourse domain is non-empty:
           ∃(K : Class) ⊤
           Typing judgment: (K : Class)

2.02) Rule Forall Instantiation (FI):
           ((∀(x : Class) φ) → φ[t/x])
           Side condition: FFI(t, v_x, φ)

2.03) Rule Exists Instantiation (EI):
           (φ[t/x] → ∃(x : Class) φ)
           Side condition: FFI(t, v_x, φ)

2.04) Rule Forall Abstraction (FA / Bernays):
           (ψ → φ) ⊢ (ψ → ∀(x : Class) φ)
           Side condition: (NFV(v_x, ψ) ∧ NFV(v_x, Γ))

2.05) Rule Exists Abstraction (EA / Bernays):
           (φ → ψ) ⊢ (∃(x : Class) (φ → ψ))
           Side condition: (NFV(v_x, ψ) ∧ NFV(v_x, Γ))

2.06) Rule Generalisation (Gen):
           φ ⊢ ∀(x : Class) φ
           Side condition: NFV(v_x, Γ)

3) Set/class-theoretic foundations of mathematics:

3.01) Axm. Class Comprehension Axiom:
           ∀(x : Class) ((x ∈ { y | φ(y) }) ⟷ (isSet(x) ∧ φ(x)))
           Side condition: NFV(v_C, φ)

3.02) Axm. Extensionality Axiom:
           ∀(A, B : Class) ((∀(x : Class) ((x ∈ A) ⟷ (x ∈ B))) → (A = B))
           Typing judgment: ((A : Class) ∧ ((B : Class) ∧ (x : Class)))

3.08) Axm. Subset-Sethood / Heredity Axiom (Subclasses of Sets are Sets):
           ∀(A, b : Class) ((isSet(b) ∧ (A ⊆ b)) → isSet(A))
           Typing judgment: ((A : Class) ∧ (b : Class))

3.12) Axm. Regularity (Foundation / Cumulative 𝒫-Induction) Axiom:
           ((∀(X : Class) ((𝒫(X) ⊆ X) → (V ⊆ X))) ∧ (∀(A : Class) ((A ≠ ∅) → ∃(x : Class) ((x ∈ A) ∧ ((x ∩ A) = ∅)))))
           Typing judgment: ((X : Class) ∧ ((A : Class) ∧ (x : Class)))

3.13) Axm. Unordered Pair Definition & Pairing Axiom:
           ∀(a, b : Class) (({a, b} = { x | ((x = a) ∨ (x = b)) }) ∧ ((isSet(a) ∧ isSet(b)) → isSet({a, b})))
           Typing judgment: ((a : Class) ∧ ((b : Class) ∧ (x : Class)))

3.14) Axm. Unary Union Definition & Union Axiom:
           ∀(a : Class) ((⋃ a = { x | ∃(y : Class) ((y ∈ a) ∧ (x ∈ y)) }) ∧ (isSet(a) → isSet(⋃ a)))
           Typing judgment: ((a : Class) ∧ ((x : Class) ∧ (y : Class)))

3.22) Def. IF-THEN-ELSE-FI (Class conditional with NFV side condition and context turnstile):
           W, Γ ⊢ (⟦IF ψ THEN A ELSE B FI⟧ = { v | ((ψ ∧ (v ∈ A)) ∨ (¬ψ ∧ (v ∈ B))) })
           Side condition: (NFV(v_v, ψ) ∧ NFV(v_v, Γ))

3.23) Def. simple_if (metalevel conditional over Type_Expression):
           ∀(T_e : Type_Expression), (simple_if(⟦T_e⟧) : (Bool → (⟦T_e⟧ → (⟦T_e⟧ → ⟦T_e⟧))))
           ∀(T_e : Type_Expression), ∀(t₁ : ⟦T_e⟧) ∀(t₂ : ⟦T_e⟧) ((simple_if(⟦T_e⟧, true, t₁, t₂) = t₁) ∧ (simple_if(⟦T_e⟧, false, t₁, t₂) = t₂))
           Typing judgment: ((T_e : Type_Expression) ∧ ((t₁ : ⟦T_e⟧) ∧ (t₂ : ⟦T_e⟧)))

3.24) Def. if_dep (dependent conditional over Bool → Type_Expression):
           ∀(T_e : (Bool → Type_Expression)), (if_dep : Π(b : Bool), ⟦T_e(true)⟧ → (⟦T_e(false)⟧ → ⟦T_e(b)⟧))
           ∀(T_e : (Bool → Type_Expression)), ∀(b : Bool) ∀(t₁ : ⟦T_e(true)⟧) ∀(t₂ : ⟦T_e(false)⟧) ((if_dep(b, t₁, t₂) : ⟦T_e(b)⟧) ∧ ((if_dep(true, t₁, t₂) = t₁) ∧ (if_dep(false, t₁, t₂) = t₂)))
           Typing judgment: ((T_e : (Bool → Type_Expression)) ∧ ((b : Bool) ∧ ((t₁ : ⟦T_e(true)⟧) ∧ (t₂ : ⟦T_e(false)⟧))))

3.32) Thm. Ordinal / Transitive-Class ∈-Induction (∈-Ind):
           ((∀(K, A : Class) ((Tr(K) ∧ ((K ∩ 𝒫(A)) ⊆ A)) → (K ⊆ A))) ∧ ((∀(x : Class) ((x ∈ On) → ((∀(y : Class) ((y ∈ x) → φ(y))) → φ(x)))) → ∀(x : Class) ((x ∈ On) → φ(x))))
           Side condition: (Fresh(v_y, v_x) ∧ NFV(v_y, φ(x)))

3.33) Def. Power Class Definition (𝒫(A)):
           ∀(A, x : Class) ((x ∈ 𝒫(A)) ⟷ (isSet(x) ∧ (x ⊆ A)))
           Side condition: Fresh(v_x, v_A)

3.34) Axm. Power Set / Exponent Axiom (Power Class of a Set is a Set):
           ∀(a : Class) (isSet(a) → isSet(𝒫(a)))
           Typing judgment: (a : Class)

3.35) Def. Size Comparison Relation (A ⪯ B / lesseq):
           ∀(A : Class) ∀(B : Class) ((A ⪯ B) ⟷ ∃(f : Class) (((isClassFunction(f) ∧ (A ⊆ Dom(f))) ∧ (f[A] ⊆ B)) ∧ isInjective(f)))
           Typing judgment: ((A : Class) ∧ ((B : Class) ∧ (f : Class)))

3.36) Def. Class Cardinality (|K|):
           ∀(K : Class) (|K| = (On ∩ ⋂({ a | ((a ∈ On) ∧ (K ⪯ a)) })))
           Typing judgment: ((K : Class) ∧ (a : Class))

3.37) Axm. Image / Replacement Axiom (isSet(F[a])):
           ∀(F, a : Class) ((isClassFunction(F) ∧ isSet(a)) → isSet(F[a]))
           Typing judgment: ((F : Class) ∧ (a : Class))

3.38) Def. Strictly Smaller Size Relation (A ≺ B):
           ∀(A : Class) ∀(B : Class) ((A ≺ B) ⟷ ¬(B ⪯ A))
           Typing judgment: ((A : Class) ∧ (B : Class))

3.39) Axm. Limitation of Size Axiom ((X ∈ V) ⟷ (|X| ≺ |V|)):
           ∀(X : Class) ((X ∈ V) ⟷ (|X| ≺ |V|))
           Typing judgment: (X : Class)

3.40) Def. Dunaev Tagged Ordered Pair:
           ∀(A, B : Class) ([A, B]_D = { z | ∃(a ∈ A) (z = {{{{a}}}, {∅}}) ∨ ∃(b ∈ B) (z = {{{{b}}}, {∅, {∅}}}) })
           Typing judgment: ((A : Class) ∧ (B : Class))

3.41) Thm. First Projection of Dunaev Tagged Ordered Pair:
           ∀(A, B : Class) ({ a | ({{{{a}}}, {∅}} ∈ [A, B]_D) } = A)
           Typing judgment: ((A : Class) ∧ (B : Class))

3.42) Thm. Second Projection of Dunaev Tagged Ordered Pair:
           ∀(A, B : Class) ({ b | ({{{{b}}}, {∅, {∅}}} ∈ [A, B]_D) } = B)
           Typing judgment: ((A : Class) ∧ (B : Class))

3.45) Axm. Infinity Axiom:
           ∃(x : Class) (isSet(x) ∧ ((∅ ∈ x) ∧ ∀(y : Class) ((y ∈ x) → ((y ∪ {y}) ∈ x))))
           Typing judgment: ((x : Class) ∧ (y : Class))

3.46) Axm. Global Choice Axiom:
           ∃(F : Class) (isClassFunction(F) ∧ ∀(x : Class) ((isSet(x) ∧ (x ≠ ∅)) → (F(x) ∈ x)))
           Typing judgment: ((F : Class) ∧ (x : Class))

3.47) Def. Universal Class (V):
           (V = { x | (x = x) })
           Typing judgment: (V : Class)

3.53) Def. Transitive Class Predicate:
           (Tr(A) ⟷ ∀(x : Class) ((x ∈ A) → (x ⊆ A)))
           Typing judgment: ((A : Class) ∧ (x : Class))

3.66) Axm. Tarski's Axiom of Universes:
           ∀(x : Class) (isSet(x) → ∃(u : Class) ((isUniverse(u) ∧ (x ∈ u)) ∧ isSet(u)))
           Typing judgment: ((x : Class) ∧ (u : Class))

3.67) Def. Semi-Singleton Class Predicate (semi_singleton):
           (semi_singleton(s) ⟷ ∀(x : Class) ∀(y : Class) (((x ∈ s) ∧ (y ∈ s)) → (x = y)))
           Typing judgment: ((s : Class) ∧ ((x : Class) ∧ (y : Class)))

3.68) Def. Semi-Singleton Subset Relation (s sss A):
           ∀(s : Class) ∀(A : Class) ((s sss A) ⟷ ((s ⊆ A) ∧ ∀(x : Class) ∀(y : Class) (((x ∈ s) ∧ (y ∈ s)) → (x = y))))
           Typing judgment: ((s : Class) ∧ ((A : Class) ∧ ((x : Class) ∧ (y : Class))))

3.69) Thm. Theorem of Evaluation of a Family (F(x) = ⋃{ s | [x, s]_D ∈ F } and (Λx, t)(z) = t[z/x]):
           ∀(F : Class) ∀(x : Class) (isFamily(F) → (F(x) = ⋃({ s | ([x, s]_D ∈ F) })))
           Typing judgment: ((F : Class) ∧ ((x : Class) ∧ ((z : Class) ∧ ((s : Class) ∧ ((t : Class.Expression) ∧ ((v_x : Variable) ∧ (v_s : Variable)))))))
           Side condition: (FFI(z, v_x, (s sss t)) ∧ (Fresh(v_s, v_x) ∧ NFV(v_s, t)))

3.70) Def. Set-Theoretic Model of Dependent Sum (ΣB / Sigma Model):
           ∀(B : Class) ∀(x : Class) ∀(y : Class) (isFamily(B) → (((x ∈ Dom(B)) ∧ (y ∈ B(x))) ⟷ ([x, y]_D ∈ { s | ∃(a : Class) ∃(b : Class) ((s = [a, b]_D) ∧ ((a ∈ Dom(B)) ∧ (b ∈ B(a)))) })))
           Typing judgment: ((B : Class) ∧ ((x : Class) ∧ ((y : Class) ∧ ((s : Class) ∧ ((a : Class) ∧ (b : Class))))))

3.71) Def. Set-Theoretic Model of Dependent Product (ΠB / Pi Predicate & Set-Section Models):
           ∀(B : Class) ∀(f : Class) ((isFamily(B) ∧ (isFamily(f) ∧ (Dom(f) = Dom(B)))) → ∀(x : Class) ((x ∈ Dom(B)) → (f(x) ∈ B(x))))
           Typing judgment: ((B : Class) ∧ ((f : Class) ∧ (x : Class)))

3.72) Thm. Subclass Antisymmetry via Extensionality:
           ∀(X : Class) ∀(Y : Class) (((X ⊆ Y) ∧ (Y ⊆ X)) → (X = Y))
           Typing judgment: ((X : Class) ∧ (Y : Class))

3.73) Thm. Singleton-to-Unordered-Pair & Intersection-to-Union Inclusions:
           ∀(a : Class) ∀(b : Class) (({a} ⊆ {a, b}) ∧ (({b} ⊆ {a, b}) ∧ ((a ∩ b) ⊆ (a ∪ b))))
           Typing judgment: ((a : Class) ∧ (b : Class))

4) Metalogical laws:

4.01) Axm. Instantiation Axiom:
           ∀(T_e : Type_Expression), ∀(G : Ctx) ∀(φ : Fm) ∀(t : ⟦T_e⟧) ∀(v : Variable) ((W, G ⊢ (∀(v : ⟦T_e⟧) φ)) → (W, G ⊢ (let v = t in φ)))
           Typing judgment: ((T_e : Type_Expression) ∧ ((t : ⟦T_e⟧) ∧ (v : Variable)))

4.02) Axm. Generalisation Axiom:
           ∀(T_e : Type_Expression), ∀(Γ : Ctx) ∀(φ : Fm) ∀(v : Variable) (¬(Enc(v) ∈ Ctx.FV(Γ)) → ((W, Γ ⊢ φ) → (W, Γ ⊢ ∀(v : ⟦T_e⟧) φ)))
           Typing judgment: ((T_e : Type_Expression) ∧ ((Γ : Ctx) ∧ ((φ : Fm) ∧ (v : Variable))))
           Side condition: NFV(v, Γ)

4.03) Rule CoNecessitation:
           (F, [] ⊢ ‹F, Γ ⊢ φ›) ⊢ (F, Γ ⊢ φ)
           Typing judgment: ((F : Theory) ∧ ((Γ : Ctx) ∧ (φ : Fm)))

4.04) Def. Quantifier Unique (!):
           ∀(φ : Fm) ((!(z : Class) φ) ⟷ ∀(x, y : Class) ((φ[x/z] ∧ φ[y/z]) → (x = y)))
           Typing judgment: ((z : Variable) ∧ ((x : Variable) ∧ (y : Variable)))

4.05) Def. Quantifier Exists and Unique (∃!):
           ∀(φ : Fm) (T, [] ⊢ ((∃!(x : Class) φ) ⟷ ((∃(x : Class) φ) ∧ !(x : Class) φ)))
           Typing judgment: ((x : Variable) ∧ (φ : Fm))

4.06) Axm. Class Comprehension Axiom (Metatheory):
           ∀(φ : Fm) ∀(x : Name) ∀(k : Class.Expr) (FFI(k, x, φ) → (T, [] ⊢ ((k ∈ { x | φ }) ⟷ (isSet(k) ∧ φ[k/x]))))
           Side condition: FFI(k, x, φ)

4.07) Axm. Completeness / Reflection & Soundness of Full Theory F:
           ∀(φ : Fm) (((F, [] ⊢ φ) → ⟦φ⟧) ∧ (⟦φ⟧ → (F, [] ⊢ φ)))
           Typing judgment: ((φ : Fm) ∧ (F : Theory))

4.08) Axm. Theory Inclusion (Model(T) ⊆ Model(F)):
           ∀(Γ : Ctx) ∀(φ : Fm) ((T, Γ ⊢ φ) → (F, Γ ⊢ φ))
           Typing judgment: ((T : Theory) ∧ ((F : Theory) ∧ ((Γ : Ctx) ∧ (φ : Fm))))

4.09) Def. Syntactic Encoding Operator (Enc):
           ∀(T_e : Type_Expression), ∀(s : ⟦T_e⟧) (isSet(Enc(s)) ∧ (Enc(s) ∈ Emb(⟦T_e⟧)))
           Typing judgment: ((T_e : Type_Expression) ∧ (s : ⟦T_e⟧))

4.10) Def. Syntactic Decoding & Roundtrip Law (Dec):
           ∀(T_e : Type_Expression), ∀(s : ⟦T_e⟧) ((Dec(Enc(s), Emb(⟦T_e⟧)) : ⟦T_e⟧) = (s : ⟦T_e⟧))
           Typing judgment: ((T_e : Type_Expression) ∧ (s : ⟦T_e⟧))

4.11) Def. Dual Type Embedding Operator (Emb):
           ∀(X : Class) ((Emb(Class)(X) ⟷ ⊤) ∧ (Emb(Set)(X) ⟷ isSet(X)))
           Typing judgment: (X : Class)

4.12) Def. Proof-Object Class Family (ProofsOf):
           ∀(s : Stmt) ∀(p : Prf) ((Enc(p) ∈ ProofsOf(Enc(s))) ⟷ CheckProof(p, s))
           Typing judgment: ((s : Stmt) ∧ (p : Prf))

4.13) Def. Class of Provable Statements (Theorems):
           ∀(s : Stmt) ((Enc(s) ∈ Theorems) ⟷ (∃(p : Class) (p ∈ ProofsOf(Enc(s)))))
           Typing judgment: ((s : Stmt) ∧ (p : Class))

5) Tactics and inference rules:

5.01) Thm. Elementary Theorems:
           ((F, [(b ∈ X)] ⊢ ∃(X : Class) (b ∈ X)) ∧ (F, [(b ∈ X)] ⊢ isSet(b)))
           Typing judgment: ((b : Class) ∧ (X : Class))

5.02) Rule Definition to Introduction Rule:
           (F, [(b ∈ X)] ⊢ ∃(X : Class) (b ∈ X)) ⊢ (F, [(b ∈ X)] ⊢ isSet(b))
           Typing judgment: ((b : Class) ∧ (X : Class))

5.03) Rule Deduction Rule Application:
           (F, [] ⊢ ((b ∈ X) → isSet(b)))
           Typing judgment: ((b : Class) ∧ (X : Class))

5.04) Thm. Tactics Proof Example:
           F, [] ⊢ ((∃(Y : Class) ∀(x : Class) (x ∈ Y)) → ∀(x : Class) ∃(Y : Class) (x ∈ Y))
           Typing judgment: ((x : Class) ∧ (Y : Class))

6) Incompleteness-related statements:

6.01) Axm. Theories (Metalevel Stratification):
           ((Model(W) ⊆ Model(Q)) ∧ ((Model(Q) ⊆ Model(T)) ∧ (Model(T) ⊆ Model(F))))
           Typing judgment: ((W : Theory) ∧ ((Q : Theory) ∧ ((T : Theory) ∧ (F : Theory))))

6.02) Thm. Löb's Theorem:
           ∀(φ : Fm) (Q, [] ⊢ ((T, [] ⊢ ((T, [] ⊢ φ) → φ)) → (T, [] ⊢ φ)))
           Typing judgment: (φ : Fm)

6.03) Thm. Gödel's Second Incompleteness Theorem:
           Q, [] ⊢ (¬(T, [] ⊢ ⊥) → ¬(T, [] ⊢ ¬(T, [] ⊢ ⊥)))
           Typing judgment: ((T : Theory) ∧ (Q : Theory))

empty_class_no_elements:
    (∀(z : Class)  ((z ∈ { x | ⊥ }) → ⊥))
    proof AST size: 7 (normalized: 7)

empty_class_is_subclass:
    (∀(X : Class) (∀(z : Class)  ((z ∈ { x | ⊥ }) → (z ∈ X))))
    proof AST size: 8 (normalized: 8)

universal_class_characterization:
    (∀(z : Class) (((z ∈ { x | ⊤ }) → isSet(z)) ∧ (isSet(z) → (z ∈ { x | ⊤ }))))
    proof AST size: 15 (normalized: 15)

russell_class_is_not_a_set:
    (isSet({ x | ((x ∈ x) → ⊥) }) → ⊥)
    proof AST size: 19 (normalized: 32)

binary_inter_comm:
    (∀(A : Class) (∀(B : Class) (∀(z : Class) (((z ∈ { x | ((x ∈ A) ∧ (x ∈ B)) }) → (z ∈ { x | ((x ∈ B) ∧ (x ∈ A)) })) ∧ ((z ∈ { x | ((x ∈ B) ∧ (x ∈ A)) }) → (z ∈ { x | ((x ∈ A) ∧ (x ∈ B)) }))))))
    proof AST size: 50 (normalized: 50)

binary_union_comm:
    (∀(A : Class) (∀(B : Class) (∀(z : Class) (((z ∈ { x | ((x ∈ A) ∨ (x ∈ B)) }) → (z ∈ { x | ((x ∈ B) ∨ (x ∈ A)) })) ∧ ((z ∈ { x | ((x ∈ B) ∨ (x ∈ A)) }) → (z ∈ { x | ((x ∈ A) ∨ (x ∈ B)) }))))))
    proof AST size: 44 (normalized: 44)

class_diff_subclass_left:
    (∀(A : Class) (∀(B : Class) (∀(z : Class) ((z ∈ { x | ((x ∈ A) ∧ ((x ∈ B) → ⊥)) }) → (z ∈ A)))))
    proof AST size: 10 (normalized: 10)

class_eq_sym:
    (∀(X : Class) (∀(Y : Class)  ((X = Y) → (Y = X))))
    proof AST size: 6 (normalized: 6)

class_eq_trans:
    (∀(X : Class) (∀(Y : Class) (∀(Z : Class) (((X = Y) ∧ (Y = Z)) → (X = Z)))))
    proof AST size: 9 (normalized: 9)

quantifier_swap:
    (∀(R : Class) ((∃(y : Set)  (∀(x : Set)  ([x, y]_D ∈ R))) → (∀(x : Set)  (∃(y : Set)  ([x, y]_D ∈ R)))))
    proof AST size: 8 (normalized: 8)

dunaev_tagged_pair_projections:
    (∀(A : Class) (∀(B : Class) ((π₁([A, B]_D) = A) ∧ (π₂([A, B]_D) = B))))
    proof AST size: 3 (normalized: 3)

cantor_diagonal_theorem:
    (∀(S : Class) (∀(R : Class) (∀(c : Class) ((c ∈ S) → ((∀(z : Class) (((z ∈ { x | ((x ∈ S) ∧ (([x, x]_D ∈ R) → ⊥)) }) → ([c, z]_D ∈ R)) ∧ (([c, z]_D ∈ R) → (z ∈ { x | ((x ∈ S) ∧ (([x, x]_D ∈ R) → ⊥)) })))) → ⊥)))))
    proof AST size: 36 (normalized: 67)

self_in_singleton:
    (∀(x : Class) (isSet(x) → (x ∈ { u | (u = x) })))
    proof AST size: 8 (normalized: 8)

self_in_succ:
    (∀(x : Class) (isSet(x) → (x ∈ { u | ((u ∈ x) ∨ (u = x)) })))
    proof AST size: 9 (normalized: 9)

class_sub_succ:
    (∀(x : Class) (∀(z : Class) ((z ∈ x) → (z ∈ { u | ((u ∈ x) ∨ (u = x)) }))))
    proof AST size: 12 (normalized: 12)

dunaev_pair_injective:
    (∀(A : Class) (∀(B : Class) (∀(C : Class) (∀(E : Class) (([A, B]_D = [C, E]_D) → ((A = C) ∧ (B = E)))))))
    proof AST size: 26 (normalized: 26)

dunaev_cartesian_elim:
    (∀(A : Class) (∀(B : Class) (∀(p : Class) ((p ∈ { q | (∃(u : Set) (∃(v : Set) (((u ∈ A) ∧ (v ∈ B)) ∧ (q = [u, v]_D)))) }) → (∃(u : Set) (∃(v : Set) (((u ∈ A) ∧ (v ∈ B)) ∧ (p = [u, v]_D))))))))
    proof AST size: 9 (normalized: 9)

inter_sub_left:
    (∀(A : Class) (∀(B : Class) (∀(z : Class) ((z ∈ { u | ((u ∈ A) ∧ (u ∈ B)) }) → (z ∈ A)))))
    proof AST size: 10 (normalized: 10)

inter_sub_right:
    (∀(A : Class) (∀(B : Class) (∀(z : Class) ((z ∈ { u | ((u ∈ A) ∧ (u ∈ B)) }) → (z ∈ B)))))
    proof AST size: 10 (normalized: 10)

union_sub_left:
    (∀(A : Class) (∀(B : Class) (∀(z : Class) ((z ∈ A) → (z ∈ { u | ((u ∈ A) ∨ (u ∈ B)) })))))
    proof AST size: 13 (normalized: 13)

semi_singleton_sub_elim:
    (∀(s : Class) (∀(A : Class) (∀(x : Class) (∀(y : Class) (((∀(u : Class)  ((u ∈ s) → (u ∈ A))) ∧ (∀(u : Class) (∀(v : Class) (((u ∈ s) ∧ (v ∈ s)) → (u = v))))) → (((x ∈ s) ∧ (y ∈ s)) → ((x ∈ A) ∧ (x = y))))))))
    proof AST size: 19 (normalized: 19)

family_fiber_char:
    (∀(A : Class) (∀(s : Class) ((s ∈ { u | (u ⊆ A) }) → (isSet(s) ∧ (s ⊆ A)))))
    proof AST size: 7 (normalized: 7)

sigma_dependent_sum_intro:
    (∀(B : Class) (∀(x : Set) (∀(y : Set) ((isSet([x, y]_D) ∧ ((x ∈ Dom(B)) ∧ (y ∈ ValOf(B, x)))) → ([x, y]_D ∈ { p | (∃(a : Set) (∃(b : Set) (((a ∈ Dom(B)) ∧ (b ∈ ValOf(B, a))) ∧ (p = [a, b]_D)))) })))))
    proof AST size: 16 (normalized: 16)

pi_dependent_product_elim:
    (∀(B : Class) (∀(f : Class) (∀(x : Class) (((∀(u : Class) ((u ∈ Dom(B)) → (ValOf(f, u) ∈ ValOf(B, u)))) ∧ (x ∈ Dom(B))) → (ValOf(f, x) ∈ ValOf(B, x))))))
    proof AST size: 10 (normalized: 10)

union_sub_right:
    (∀(A : Class) (∀(B : Class) (∀(z : Class) ((z ∈ B) → (z ∈ { u | ((u ∈ A) ∨ (u ∈ B)) })))))
    proof AST size: 13 (normalized: 13)

model_stratification_trans:
    (∀(W : Class) (∀(Q : Class) (∀(T : Class) (∀(F : Class) (((∀(z : Class) ((z ∈ Model(W)) → (z ∈ Model(Q)))) ∧ ((∀(z : Class) ((z ∈ Model(Q)) → (z ∈ Model(T)))) ∧ (∀(z : Class) ((z ∈ Model(T)) → (z ∈ Model(F)))))) → (∀(z : Class) ((z ∈ Model(W)) → (z ∈ Model(F)))))))))
    proof AST size: 22 (normalized: 22)

if_dep_true_elim:
    (∀(A : Class) (∀(T1 : Class) (∀(T2 : Class) (∀(x : Class) (∀(z : Class) (((((x ∈ A) → (if_dep(x, A, ValOf(T1, x), ValOf(T2, x)) = ValOf(T1, x))) ∧ (((x ∈ A) → ⊥) → (if_dep(x, A, ValOf(T1, x), ValOf(T2, x)) = ValOf(T2, x)))) ∧ ((x ∈ A) ∧ (z ∈ if_dep(x, A, ValOf(T1, x), ValOf(T2, x))))) → (z ∈ ValOf(T1, x))))))))
    proof AST size: 17 (normalized: 17)

if_dep_false_elim:
    (∀(A : Class) (∀(T1 : Class) (∀(T2 : Class) (∀(x : Class) (∀(z : Class) (((((x ∈ A) → (if_dep(x, A, ValOf(T1, x), ValOf(T2, x)) = ValOf(T1, x))) ∧ (((x ∈ A) → ⊥) → (if_dep(x, A, ValOf(T1, x), ValOf(T2, x)) = ValOf(T2, x)))) ∧ (((x ∈ A) → ⊥) ∧ (z ∈ if_dep(x, A, ValOf(T1, x), ValOf(T2, x))))) → (z ∈ ValOf(T2, x))))))))
    proof AST size: 17 (normalized: 17)

inter_idempotent_elim:
    (∀(A : Class) (∀(z : Class) ((z ∈ { u | ((u ∈ A) ∧ (u ∈ A)) }) → (z ∈ A))))
    proof AST size: 9 (normalized: 9)

singleton_membership_eq:
    (∀(a : Class) (∀(z : Class) ((z ∈ { u | (u = a) }) → (z = a))))
    proof AST size: 8 (normalized: 8)
